title: State v. Witt (N.J. 2015)
key_points: Holding: NJ allows a warrantless on-scene vehicle search when probable cause arises from unforeseeable and spontaneous circumstances. If the car is towed and impounded, get a warrant.
officer_notes: Scenario: During a stop for a traffic violation you see a handgun's grip under the seat. You search the car at the roadside.
Takeaway: Search at the scene or get a warrant; don't tow first and search later without one.
